title: Given Facts
author: UncleLogic
rules:
Given Facts is a Sudoku variant combining general-knowledge numerical clues with standard Sudoku logic.

Sudoku:

Place the digits 1–9 in every row, column, and 3×3 box, with no repeats.

Fact Entries:

Outlined groups of cells correspond to the numbered Across and Down clues below. Enter each numerical answer into its outlined cells in reading order.

The number in parentheses shows how many digits are in the answer.

All digits entered as part of a Fact Entry must also obey normal Sudoku rules.

You do not need to know every fact immediately. If you are unsure of an answer, continue solving the Sudoku — information from the grid may help reveal it.

Across:

A1 (2) — What is 2 to the fifth power?

A2 (4) — What are the first four prime numbers, written consecutively?

A3 (3) — What is the usual house number of the Simpson family on Evergreen Terrace?

A4 (2) — How many cells are in a standard 9×9 Sudoku grid?

A5 (4) — In what year did World War II end?

A6 (3) — What are the side lengths of the smallest integer-sided right triangle, written in ascending order?

A7 (3) — What is 9 cubed?

A8 (4) — What year is the title of George Orwell's novel Nineteen Eighty-Four?

A9 (2) — What is 7 × 8?

Down:

D1 (2) — How many squares are on a standard chessboard?

D2 (2) — How many cards are in a standard deck, excluding jokers?

D3 (4) — In what year did Christopher Columbus's first voyage reach the Caribbean?

D4 (2) — What is the atomic number of uranium?

D5 (3) — What are the first three digits of pi, ignoring the decimal point?

D6 (2) — How many founding member countries did the United Nations have in 1945?

There are no ordinary given digits.

About Given Facts:

This puzzle is a proof of concept for a possible fuller puzzle format for UncleLogic.com, combining general-knowledge numerical clues with Sudoku. I'd especially appreciate feedback on whether the trivia/Sudoku interaction is enjoyable and whether you would be interested in a version where the entire grid is built around clues.

I hope you enjoy it!

More puzzles by me can be found at UncleLogic.com.
solutionCode: Enter the digits in Row 7 from left to right.
